scientific_interpretation.disagreement_tail_offset_glm: The preregistered offset-logit GLM log_ratio coefficient moves closer to zero at 10m: CONTROL -1.372557987064978 -> VALUES_ABLATION -1.3356615240473628. Thus tail diagnostics are mixed rather than uniformly improved.

scientific_interpretation.mechanism_status: Historical odds/popularity are not established as the universal or primary root cause. Current evidence supports at most a subgroup-local partial contribution. Because preregistered disagreement-tail diagnostics are mixed, the conservative AND interpretation remains not satisfied.
scientific_interpretation.gate_status: No Gate promotion, strategy change, threshold change, odds filter, feature adoption, subgroup mutation, snapshot mutation, or metric mutation is authorized.
scientific_interpretation.oos_status: 2025H2 remains retrospective/hypothesis-forming diagnostic evidence, not untouched OOS. 2026 sealed outcomes remain prohibited.

inferential_followup.prereg_search: No bootstrap, permutation, significance, or clustering procedure for an arm-to-arm Q5 gap difference was preregistered in T009R_HISTORICAL_MARKET_FEATURE_ABLATION_PREREG_V1.
inferential_followup.validity_note: Do not manufacture a confirmatory p-value from aggregate Q5 summaries. Q5 membership is recomputed per arm, so a valid arm-difference test requires row/race-level predictions for both arms or exact reproducible regeneration. Any newly chosen inferential test on 2025H2 is retrospective sensitivity analysis only.

unresolved: A genuinely sealed/untouched outcome period has not yet tested reproduction of the fixed >=2x CONTROL calibration gap and frozen ablation effect.

The sampling uncertainty of the 10m Q5 arm difference (~+0.00124779) cannot be validly estimated from the stored aggregate summaries alone; row/race-level per-arm outputs or exact regeneration are required.
Candidate pre-cutoff race-day information sources that could explain market/model disagreement remain untested.
